---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability, platform adapter, conflict cluster, vet rule or synonym
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

<!-- What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way? Describe the situation, not the solution. -->

## Proposal

<!-- What should change? Keep it as small as the problem allows. -->

## Kind of change

- [ ] New or corrected platform adapter (data in `orchestrator/data/platforms.json`)
- [ ] New conflict cluster (data in `orchestrator/data/conflicts.json`)
- [ ] New or changed vet rule
- [ ] Synonym group or phrase for search
- [ ] New command or option
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Evidence

<!--
Platform adapter: observed behavior, or a link to official documentation, plus the platform version.
Conflict cluster: the two or more skills or tools that overlap, with links.
Vet rule: a public example of the pattern, and a near-miss that must not match.
Synonym: the prompt that missed and the skill it should have found.
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Including "do nothing" and "use an existing option". -->

## Constraints check

- [ ] Works with the standard library only
- [ ] Needs no network access at runtime
- [ ] Can be expressed as data rather than code (if not, say why)

## Willing to contribute?

<!-- Yes or no. A pull request with tests is the fastest route. -->
